claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM the compound is expected to be largely inactive, since glucocorticoid receptor agonists typically produce cytostatic rather than cytotoxic effects and no class in the vocabulary shares a glucocorticoid-driven killing pattern.
